view: evidence-snapshot
alt: The recorded resource snapshot for the same run: the initial check, the calculation, the repaired check, and the final report, each linked to the event that produced it.
caption: From a failed check to a verified repair to a report, reconstructed only from recorded effects.

view: overview
alt: The signed-in local workroom home screen, showing the panel to launch a scripted control and an empty run detail pane before any run is selected.
caption: A local workroom for launching scripted instrument controls before any run has been selected.

view: run-detail
alt: The detail view of the truthful-repair scripted run: its status and call budget, the recorded evaluation report, and the six separate outcome checks with the events that support each one.
caption: One recorded scripted run: its budget, evaluation report, and each separate outcome check, all traced to events.

view: run-list
alt: The recorded-run inventory listing three completed scripted demonstration runs, next to collapsed panels for replay, comparison, and study tools.
caption: The run inventory: every scripted demonstration is recorded and listed for inspection, nothing hidden.

view: trace-ledger
alt: The same run's committed events shown actor-by-actor in a lane table, distinguishing recorded permission (gate) decisions from applied effects.
caption: Every actor's committed events in one ledger: who proposed, who decided, what actually changed.

view: tui-cockpit
alt: The terminal cockpit attached to the same local workroom: the run inventory, one run's overview, and its committed event ledger, plus a status line and a local-provider readiness warning.
caption: The same recorded evidence, observed from a terminal cockpit instead of the browser.

view: Compass Observatory dashboard — Chronicle tab
alt: The current example task the tool is tracking, plus a handful of example notes it remembered while working on that task.
caption: The Chronicle tab: the active session goal plus recent recorded insights, the memory half of T2Helix's helix.

view: Compass Observatory dashboard — hero (Live Feed tab, full instrument bar)
alt: The tool's real-time safety dashboard: a scrolling feed of example commands with the allow/pause/block decision made about each one, alongside the header showing how many decisions have fired this session.
caption: T2Helix's local Compass Observatory dashboard — a real-time feed of every pre-action WITNESS, PAUSE, and OPEN classification the compass makes.

view: Compass Observatory dashboard — Live Feed tab
alt: A live list of example commands and the safety verdict the tool gave each one (allow, soft-block, or hard-block), with the matched rule and reason shown underneath.
caption: T2Helix's local Compass Observatory dashboard: the Live Feed tab showing WITNESS, PAUSE, and OPEN pre-action classifications with rule names and reasons.

view: Compass Observatory dashboard — Review Queue tab
alt: A single example of a reusable procedure the tool noticed on its own, waiting in a review queue for a person to approve or reject before it becomes a trusted method.
caption: The Review Queue tab: a quarantined method candidate awaiting a human decision to promote or dismiss it.

view: Interior View dashboard — accepted turn, full 12-stage pipeline
alt: The project's built-in observability dashboard, showing one example question that the local model's answer passed every check for and was accepted.
caption: Interior View: every turn's 12-stage substrate pipeline, replayed offline from a scripted example.

view: Interior View dashboard — rejected turn, Final decision panel
alt: The same dashboard on a second example question, where the substrate's validator caught the model's answer just repeating the goal back and rejected it before it was ever shown or saved, with the reason listed plainly.
caption: A rejected turn: the substrate's mechanical validator catches a goal-echo and withholds the answer.

view: dashboard, normal scenario assessed, supported finding
alt: A dashboard reviews a simple synthetic sensor snapshot and shows a supported, evidence-backed finding with no alarms reported.
caption: Reviews a synthetic sensor snapshot and shows a supported finding grounded in the evidence, with no control action taken.

view: dashboard, stale scenario assessed, withheld finding
alt: A dashboard withholds an assessment because the observation is older than its 60-second freshness budget, instead of guessing from stale data.
caption: Withholds its assessment outright when a synthetic observation is too old, rather than reasoning from stale data.

view: evidence / receipt chain panel, expanded
alt: The evidence panel expanded to show the run's recorded receipt as hash-linked JSON, alongside the assessed observation and finding above it.
caption: Every assessment is recorded as a hash-linked evidence receipt that can be expanded and inspected.

view: hero: full workbench, normal scenario assessed
alt: The full workbench landing view: brand header and mission statement, scenario picker, an assessed synthetic observation with a supported finding, and the start of the evidence section.
caption: An evidence-first research workbench: observe a synthetic snapshot, get a grounded finding, and inspect the receipt behind it.

view: browser dashboard (Cosmic Mission Control), hero/full view
alt: Full-size view of the same dashboard: verdict tiles, the 3-hour activity chart (flat/empty), and the three side-by-side panels (compass log, chronicle feed, pending gates + missions).
caption: Mission Control's full layout: verdict tiles, a 3-hour activity chart, and live compass/chronicle/mission panels.

view: browser dashboard (Cosmic Mission Control), overview
alt: The read-only browser dashboard (normally at port 4333) showing the two synthetic scripted missions above in its 'Missions' tile and panel, while the compass/insight/goal panels are honestly empty because no T2Helix compass activity was generated.
caption: Cosmic Mission Control: a read-only browser view over the same mission log, compass verdicts, and chronicle receipts.

view: terminal, `cosmic-cli do` mission ending needs_review
alt: The CLI's own status rendering after a scripted mission reads a small notes file and declares itself finished; because no operator verifier command was configured, the mission ends 'needs_review (model_declared)' in yellow rather than being called complete.
caption: A finished mission is only ever 'verified' or 'needs_review' — never a bare 'complete' — and the terminal always names which one and why.

view: terminal, `cosmic-cli do` mission ending verified
alt: The same scripted mission, this time with an operator-supplied verifier command configured; the CLI runs it through its gated shell path, the verifier reports success, and the mission ends 'verified (verifier)' in green.
caption: 'Verified' is reserved for a finished mission whose operator-supplied check actually passed — not for the model's own say-so.

view: element explorer: Helium property panel open
alt: The element library opened to Helium, with its property panel showing atomic mass, electronegativity, and other fields each tagged with an explicit scientific status such as measured/evaluated, unverified, or unavailable.
caption: Every element property carries an explicit scientific status: measured, unverified, or withheld rather than guessed.

view: guided lesson: bonding coach walking through building water
alt: The bonding coach's guided build for water in progress: numbered practice atoms on the 3D bench with a highlighted suggested bond, a step counter, and an explicit note that the layout is not a calculated geometry.
caption: A bonding coach walks through building a known molecule step by step, with numbered atoms and undoable hints.

view: hero: default studio landing on benzene
alt: The full molecular studio on first load: the molecule collection on the left, benzene's 3D ball-and-stick model in the live viewport, and a structure-insights panel with a bonding-coach suggestion on the right.
caption: An interactive 3D chemistry studio: explore reference molecules, build structures, and see chemistry take shape.

view: molecule builder: water preset loaded in the 3D bench
alt: The water preset loaded onto the editable 3D bench, with its bent H2O geometry, species card, and cited formation-enthalpy data in the structure-insights panel.
caption: Load a reference molecule like water onto an editable 3D bench and inspect its cited structure data.

view: Reaction lab: default methane combustion, balanced with cited thermodynamics
alt: The Reaction lab dialog showing methane combustion declared by the user, automatically balanced, with limiting reagent, theoretical yields, and cited 298.15 K enthalpy/free-energy/equilibrium totals sourced from NIST WebBook.
caption: Declare a reaction from the library; the app balances it and totals cited formation data, without predicting outcomes.
